in_marathi.name: Durgaprasad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgaprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durgaprasad is a name that signifies the grace and blessings of Goddess Durga. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Durga’, meaning ‘the invincible’, and ‘Prasad’, meaning ‘grace’ or ‘blessings’. In Hindu mythology, Durga is a goddess who represents strength, courage, and protection. The name Durgaprasad is believed to bring the blessings of this powerful goddess to the bearer.
